xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3727: Sweeper ghost escalations for closed issues — close-out leaves open recovery trips + stop gates; parked resolver's closed-check fails open on tracker blips

plan.title: Sweeper ghost escalations for closed issues — close-out residue + resolver record-terminal evidence
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

metadata.sizeJustification: One behavioral fix whose writes live in single-responsibility door modules (recovery-trip, agent-state, record-update) and whose reads live in the parked resolver; the ghost-escalation class stays open unless close-out ack, resolver hardening, reopen truth, and the backlog sweep land together, so sibling-issue decomposition would strand half-fixes behind separate review cycles.

narratives.Problem: The stall sweeper escalates parked rows for issues that are already merged and closed (observed on MIN-941, Done in Linear since 2026-08-06: ghost sweep.escalated events on 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-14). Close-out never acknowledges open recovery trips and leaves stoppedByUser flags on preserved agent rows; the parked resolver's only terminality evidence for non-live issues is a live tracker call that fails open toward 'open' and negative-caches for 5 minutes, so one Linear blip resurrects a closed issue into the parked population long enough for the 24h re-surface TTL to fire an operator escalation.
narratives.Proposal: Four changes behind existing door patterns: (1) closeOut() gains a residue-ack step that acknowledges every open recovery trip (new acknowledgeAllOpenRecoveryTrips door extracted from pan parked ack) and clears operator-gate flags on the issue's stopped agent rows (new clearAgentOperatorGatesForIssueSync door); (2) resolveParkedPopulation treats record-level terminality (pipeline.closedOut === true, or pipeline.mergeStatus === 'merged' with reopenedAt unset) as decisive — no tracker call, non-zombie orbits suppressed; (3) clearRecordPipelineClosedOut(Sync) also drops a stale mergeStatus='merged' so reopened issues are never record-terminal; (4) a new reconcileTerminalIssueResidue patrol in the deacon (hourly, beside the state-plane patrol) cleans existing terminal-issue residue across all projects.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing isLinearIssueClosed / isTrackerIssueClosed fail-closed posture (protects the destructive reaper; deliberately untouched)
- Changing the sweeper's 24h re-surface TTL or escalation copy
- Pruning or deleting preserved agent state dirs / retained transcripts (only gate flags are cleared)
- A one-time operator-run cleanup CLI (the recurring patrol's first run covers the backlog)
- Zombie-session reap semantics (record-terminal issues still produce zombie rows for live agents)
- Review-status door changes (reviewStatus rows do not survive close-out and are not the durable source)

autoDecisions.summary: Residue sweep implemented as a recurring deacon patrol instead of a one-time CLI command
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for a one-time sweep of existing residue; a patrol wired beside reconcileProjectStatePlanes (deacon.ts:3113) performs that sweep on its first run after deploy and self-heals any future leak path without operator action, matching the 'fix the system, not the symptom' engineering rule.

autoDecisions.summary: Terminal predicate includes a reopenedAt guard in addition to fixing the reopen door
autoDecisions.rationale: Records written before this fix can hold a stale mergeStatus='merged' on an already-reopened issue (reopen cleared closedOut but not mergeStatus). The guard keeps those issues visible; the door fix (WI-5) stops new staleness. Both are one-line defenses against the same hazard.

autoDecisions.summary: Close-out clears all three operator-gate flags (stoppedByUser, troubled, operator paused), not only stoppedByUser
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator-gate orbit groups all three gates (resolver.ts:276-309); clearing only stoppedByUser would leave the same ghost class reachable via a paused or troubled residue row. Scheduler yields and live agents are explicitly excluded.

autoDecisions.summary: Residue-ack failure inside closeOut() is non-blocking (stepSkipped)
autoDecisions.rationale: Close-out is the terminal ceremony for an already-merged issue; a bookkeeping ack failure must not strand it. The recurring patrol is the backstop that retries the cleanup.

items.title: Extract acknowledgeAllOpenRecoveryTrips door into recovery-trip.ts

expected_outputs: new door tests pass (2 open trips acked of 3, unresolvable issue returns 0)

narrative.Action: Move the per-issue ack loop from ackIssueTripsDefault (src/cli/commands/parked.ts:96-115) into src/lib/cloister/recovery-trip.ts as `export async function acknowledgeAllOpenRecoveryTrips(issueId: string): Promise<number>` — resolve the project via resolveProjectFromIssueSync/getProjectSync, read the record, acknowledge each open trip through the existing acknowledgeRecoveryTrip door, return the count acked (0 for unresolvable/unreadable). pan parked ack imports the door in place of its local copy with no behavior change. Add src/lib/cloister/__tests__/recovery-trip-all.test.ts covering: record with two open + one closed trip returns 2 and removes only the open trips; unresolvable issue id returns 0.

items.title: Given a record with two open trips and one closed trip, acknowledgeAllOpenRecoveryTrips returns 2 and the persisted record retains only the closed trip
Given an issue id that resolves to no project, acknowledgeAllOpenRecoveryTrips returns 0 and writes nothing
pan parked ack produces identical output to before the extraction (existing parked-ack tests pass unmodified)
Add clearAgentOperatorGatesForIssueSync door to agent-state.ts

expected_outputs: gate suite passes including the three new cases

narrative.Action: New export in src/lib/agents/agent-state.ts beside clearAgentPausedSync/clearAgentTroubledSync: `export function clearAgentOperatorGatesForIssueSync(issueId: string): string[]`. For every agent row whose issueId matches case-insensitively AND whose status === 'stopped': delete stoppedByUser; if paused === true && yieldedByScheduler !== true apply the existing applyAgentUnpaused helper; if troubled === true apply the existing untroubled helper; persist each mutated row via saveAgentStateSync. Return the mutated agent ids. Never touch running/starting agents or scheduler yields. Add tests to tests/unit/lib/agents/agent-state-gate.test.ts: stopped row with stoppedByUser gets cleared and its id returned; running row with stoppedByUser is untouched; yielded pause is untouched.

items.title: Given a stopped agent row with stoppedByUser=true, the door deletes the flag, persists via saveAgentStateSync, and returns the agent id
Given a running agent row with stoppedByUser=true, the door preserves the row unchanged and omits it from the returned ids
Given a stopped agent row paused by the scheduler (yieldedByScheduler=true), the door preserves paused and yieldedByScheduler unchanged
closeOut() acknowledges open trips and clears operator gates (close-out:ack-parked-residue step)

expected_outputs: workflows suite passes with the new residue-step case

narrative.Action: In closeOut() (src/lib/lifecycle/workflows.ts), immediately after the close-out:prune-agent-rows block (lines 416-421), add a step named close-out:ack-parked-residue that calls acknowledgeAllOpenRecoveryTrips(ctx.issueId) and clearAgentOperatorGatesForIssueSync(ctx.issueId) and pushes stepOk with `Acked N open trip(s); cleared operator gates on M agent row(s)`. On failure push stepSkipped with the error message — non-blocking, matching the posture of neighboring steps (a completed merge must never be un-closable over bookkeeping). Test in tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/workflows.test.ts: a close-out fixture with an open trip and a preserved stoppedByUser row completes with success=true, the trip removed from the record, the gate flag cleared, and a close-out:ack-parked-residue step present in result.steps.

items.title: Given a close-out fixture with an open recovery trip, closeOut() completes with the trip removed from the record and result.steps contains a passing close-out:ack-parked-residue step
Given a preserved stopped agent row with stoppedByUser=true, closeOut() completes with the flag cleared while the row and its retained transcripts survive
Given the ack door throws, closeOut() still returns success=true and records close-out:ack-parked-residue as skipped with the error message
resolveParkedPopulation treats record-terminal issues as closed without a tracker call

expected_outputs: resolver suite passes including the record-terminal and tracker-blip regression cases

narrative.Action: In src/lib/parked/resolver.ts add an optional `readRecordTerminal?: (issueId: string) => Promise<boolean>` to ResolveParkedOptions (keep readOpenTrips and isClosed signatures unchanged — tests inject them). Default `defaultReadRecordTerminal`: resolve project via resolveProjectFromIssueSync/getProjectSync, readIssueRecord, return `record.pipeline.closedOut === true || (record.pipeline.mergeStatus === 'merged' && !record.pipeline.reopenedAt)`; any throw or missing record returns false. In classifyOne (resolver.ts:459-480): when readRecordTerminal(issueId) is true, set issueClosed = true, store it in closedByIssue, skip the isClosed tracker call, and skip the trips read (trips = []). Pass 2 needs no change — closedByIssue already carries the verdict. Tests in src/lib/parked/__tests__/resolver.test.ts: (1) record-terminal issue with an open trip and a stoppedByUser row produces zero rows and an injected isClosed spy fails if called; (2) record-terminal + isClosed returning false still produces zero non-zombie rows (tracker-blip regression); (3) mergeStatus='merged' with reopenedAt set and closedOut unset is NOT terminal and classifies normally; (4) no record evidence falls back to the tracker check exactly as today.

items.title: Given a record-terminal issue (closedOut=true) with an open trip and a stoppedByUser row, resolveParkedPopulation returns zero rows for it and the injected isClosed spy is never called
Given a record-terminal issue and an isClosed that returns false (tracker blip), resolveParkedPopulation still returns zero non-zombie rows for it
Given a record with mergeStatus='merged' and reopenedAt set and closedOut unset, the resolver falls back to the tracker check and classifies the issue's rows normally
Given a record with no terminal evidence, the resolver invokes the tracker closed-check exactly as before (fallback preserved)
clearRecordPipelineClosedOut drops stale mergeStatus='merged' on reopen

expected_outputs: record-update and reopen suites pass with the new mergeStatus-clearing cases

narrative.Action: In clearRecordPipelineClosedOutSync and clearRecordPipelineClosedOut (src/lib/pan-dir/record-update.ts:127-158): inside the same mutation that clears closedOut/closedOutAt and stamps reopenedAt, delete record.pipeline.mergeStatus when it === 'merged'. Both reopen callers (src/lib/reopen.ts:90 and the state-plane patrol door at src/lib/cloister/state-plane-patrol.ts:36-40) inherit the fix. Tests: record-update.test.ts gains a case where a closed-out record with mergeStatus='merged' comes out of the door with no mergeStatus and reopenedAt stamped; tests/lib/reopen.test.ts gains a case where reopening a closed-out issue leaves the record without mergeStatus='merged'.

items.title: Given a record with closedOut=true and mergeStatus='merged', clearRecordPipelineClosedOutSync persists the record with closedOut cleared, reopenedAt stamped, and no mergeStatus
Given a closed-out issue, pan reopen leaves the record with no pipeline.mergeStatus='merged' (reopen suite proves it end-to-end)
Deacon patrol reconciles terminal-issue residue across all projects

expected_outputs: parked-residue suite passes (terminal cleaned, non-terminal untouched, door failure warns and continues)

narrative.Action: New module src/lib/cloister/parked-residue.ts exporting `reconcileTerminalIssueResidue(projects: Array<{ config: ProjectConfig }>, deps = defaultDeps()): Promise<StatePlaneReconcileAction[]>`, mirroring the deps-injection shape of reconcileProjectStatePlanes (src/lib/cloister/state-plane-patrol.ts:22-42). Default deps: listIssueRecords (src/lib/pan-dir/record-list.ts:29), acknowledgeAllOpenRecoveryTrips, clearAgentOperatorGatesForIssueSync. For each record matching the terminal predicate (closedOut === true, or mergeStatus === 'merged' with reopenedAt unset — export a shared isRecordPipelineTerminal(record) helper from the new module and reuse it in the resolver default): ack its open trips, clear its stopped rows' gates, and emit one action-level message per cleaned issue naming issue id, trips acked, and rows cleared. A door failure produces a warn action and does not stop other issues. Wire into the deacon beside the state-plane patrol call (src/lib/cloister/deacon.ts:3113) on the same statePlaneReconcileEveryCycles cadence, pushing messages into actions and addLog exactly like the neighboring patrol. Tests in src/lib/cloister/__tests__/parked-residue.test.ts with injected deps cover: terminal record with an open trip gets acked and logged; non-terminal record untouched; ack failure emits warn and later issues still process.

items.title: Given a project with a terminal record carrying an open trip, reconcileTerminalIssueResidue acknowledges the trip, clears its stopped rows' gates, and emits an action message naming the issue
Given a non-terminal record, reconcileTerminalIssueResidue calls no write doors for it
Given the ack door throws for one issue, the patrol emits a warn action for that issue and still processes the remaining issues
The deacon patrol loop invokes reconcileTerminalIssueResidue on the state-plane cadence (grep deacon.ts shows the call beside reconcileProjectStatePlanes)
Document record-first terminality and the close-out residue step

expected_outputs: the three docs name the new terminality order and residue step
